title: ENDEX — 01:30 CST: Watch Cleared, Recovery Under Way

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is 01:30 CST on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and there are no watches or warnings for Brennan County. Heavy rescue crews are still searching Corwin Wax & Candle, and casualty figures will come only from the coroner through the county. The Brennan County High School Red Cross shelter is opening based on the decisions you made, and a generator is on the way. This ends exercise play. THIS IS AN EXERCISE.
finalState: Corwin Wax & Candle: the heavy rescue search is still going. The county will release casualty figures only from the coroner.

Brennan County High School Red Cross shelter: opening, with a generator on the way. The Public Safety Building GEN-1 repair, the cell-on-wheels and the state debris crews have been requested or are under way. None of them is finished.
Sirens N-07 (Pine Hollow) and N-11 (Clarks River bridge) stay out of service until the repair on Tuesday, December 15.
The NWS Paducah storm survey team arrives in Corwin at 07:30.
The next joint county message is due at 02:30.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Stop play now. Put down the phones and radios, but keep your logs, notes and message drafts where they are and don't throw anything away. We'll take a ten-minute break and then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: Timeline walk-back, then 3-Up, 3-Down. First we rebuild the night on the wall from 21:30 to 01:30 using your logs. Then each role names three things that went well and three things that broke.
hotWashQuestions: When did we decide to open the Ashford Middle School and Corwin Community Center safe rooms, and how did the timing compare with the line arriving around 22:40? What would have made the decision easier earlier?

With N-07 and N-11 out, how many minutes passed between the 22:41 tornado warning and the moment Pine Hollow, Riverbend and Shady Acres actually got a warning by siren, BrennanAlert voice call, WEA or patrol PA? Which channel reached them first?
How did we handle the 'locked Corwin safe room' post and the 'at least six dead' report? Did the county, Channel 6 and the City of Corwin end up saying the same thing, and who confirmed it?
After the cell sites, BrennanAlert SMS and the Public Safety Building generator failed, which ways did we still have to reach the north end and our own responders? Which ones did we use?

Are the warning log, siren activation records, BrennanAlert and IPAWS logs, NWSChat transcripts and spotter reports complete enough under BWN 8 to support the NWS storm survey and the after-action report? What's missing?
fields.facilitatorNote: Before the break, collect the Warning Officer's warning log, the siren poll and activation printouts, the BrennanAlert and IPAWS message logs, the NWSChat transcript, the SKYWARN net notes, the PIO's message drafts and all evaluator sheets. Use their timestamps to build the timeline wall.
